```yaml
title: "Enabling/Disabling Whiteboard & Courseware Retention"
source_title_zh: "开启关闭“板书课件留存”"
```

## Enabling/Disabling Whiteboard & Courseware Retention

### Who this applies to
- The Admin Console primary account
- Sub-accounts with "School Settings" access

### Overview
When Whiteboard & Courseware Retention is enabled, if a certain amount of content is written on the whiteboard or on courseware during class, the resulting whiteboard notes — along with any annotated PPT, PDF, Word (docx/doc), or Epub courseware (including files that org cloud drive settings allow saving/downloading) — are automatically saved as PDFs in the session list. Both teachers and students can see them, and teachers can share them via link outside of ClassIn.

Retained whiteboard/courseware content uses storage space, and enabling this feature may incur charges. Already-generated content can be deleted from the Admin Console.

### Related articles
- "Adding Sub-accounts in the Admin Console"

### Steps
1. Log into the Admin Console.
2. Go to School Settings in the left navigation.
3. Go to Courseware & Whiteboard Retention at the top.
4. Enable or disable "auto-retain whiteboard notes / annotated courseware" under Whiteboard & Courseware Retention.

<!-- DOC_BOUNDARY -->
```yaml
title: "Auto-Deleting Storage Resources"
source_title_zh: "自动删除存储资源"
```

## Auto-Deleting Storage Resources

### Who this applies to
- The Admin Console primary account
- Sub-accounts with "School Settings" access

### Overview
Academic staff can set an auto-deletion time range in the Admin Console. Once enabled, the console will each day delete class recordings (class playback videos), class monitoring screenshots, course recording attachments, assignment attachments, quiz answer sheet attachments, discussion attachments, class files, learning material attachments, and check-in attachments that have just reached the deletion threshold.

For example, with "auto-delete recordings older than 3 months" enabled: on October 11, the system deletes recordings from July 11; on October 12, it deletes recordings from July 12; and so on. At the end of November (the 30th), it will auto-delete recordings from the last few days of August (the 30th and 31st).

Notes:
1. Uploaded "class recordings (playback videos)" have their storage duration calculated based on the session's start date.
2. Resources with protection lock enabled will not be deleted.
3. When auto-deletion is enabled, resources that have already exceeded the selected number of months won't be automatically deleted retroactively. To delete older resources, create a deletion task under "Delete Historical Storage Resources," or delete manually under "Class Monitoring/Recording" or "Course Resources."

### Related articles
- "Deleting Historical Storage Resources"
- "Adding Sub-accounts in the Admin Console"

### Steps
1. Log into the Admin Console.
2. Go to School Settings in the left navigation.
3. Go to Storage Settings at the top.
4. Under "Set Auto-Delete Storage Resources," enable or disable auto-deletion and set the deletion time range.

<!-- DOC_BOUNDARY -->
```yaml
title: "Public / Personal Authorized Resources"
source_title_zh: "公共个人授权资源"
```

## Public / Personal Authorized Resources

### I. Public authorized resources

**Who this applies to**
- The Admin Console primary account
- Sub-accounts with "Teacher Management" access

**Overview**
In Teacher Management, use the top-right button to enable or disable public authorized resources for all teachers. To manage this individually for one teacher, search for them and toggle the setting on their row — this only affects that teacher's own setting. The top-right corner also offers an option to customize public authorized resources, with up to 40 folders. Once customized and enabled, authorized teachers can view and open files from the public authorized resources in IM, the classroom, the lesson-prep room, and the whiteboard.

**Notes**
- Deactivated teachers cannot view any files in the school's cloud drive.

**Related articles**
- "Adding Sub-accounts in the Admin Console"

**Steps**
1. Log into the Admin Console.
2. Go to Teacher Management in the left navigation.
3. Enable or disable public authorized resources.
4. Use the top-right corner to customize public authorized resources.

### II. Personal authorized resources
In Teacher Management, search for a teacher and configure their personal authorized resources on their row — up to 40 folders. A teacher with personal authorized resources set can view and open those files in IM, the classroom, the lesson-prep room, and the whiteboard.

**Steps**
1. Customize personal authorized resources next to the teacher's name.

<!-- DOC_BOUNDARY -->
```yaml
title: "Class Files, Attachments & Co-Creation Management"
source_title_zh: "班级文件、附件、共创管理"
```

## Class Files, Attachments & Co-Creation Management

### I. Preventing course attachments and class files from being deleted

**Who this applies to**
- The Admin Console primary account
- Sub-accounts with "Class Resources" access

**When to use this**
Academic staff can enable a protection lock for a class's "course attachments," "class files," and "class co-creation" content in the Admin Console. Once locked, this content cannot be deleted — even via a deletion task or "delete by time range" — protecting against accidental deletion caused by mistakes or mismanagement.

**Related articles**
- "Adding Sub-accounts in the Admin Console"

**Steps**
1. Log into the Admin Console.
2. Go to Class Resources in the left navigation.
3. Find the class.
4. Click "Protection Lock" on the right (green lock = protection enabled; gray lock = protection disabled).

### II. Deleting course attachments and class files
To avoid using unnecessary storage space, you can delete "course attachments," "class files," or "class co-creation" content you no longer need to keep in a class.

**Notes**
- Deleting "course attachments," "class files," or "class co-creation" content in the Admin Console also deletes the corresponding content in the class within the ClassIn app.

**Steps**
1. Select the course(s).
2. Delete the resources.

<!-- DOC_BOUNDARY -->
```yaml
title: "Deleting Historical Storage Resources"
source_title_zh: "删除历史存储资源"
```

## Deleting Historical Storage Resources

### What is "Deleting Historical Storage Resources"?
This feature lets academic staff create a deletion task in the Admin Console for a specific time range. The task will permanently delete class recordings (playback videos), monitoring screenshots, course recording attachments, assignment attachments, quiz answer sheet attachments, discussion attachments, class files, learning material attachments, and check-in attachments from within that time range.

### Who this applies to
- The Admin Console primary account
- Sub-accounts with "School Settings" access

### When to use this
This feature is mainly used to delete the above resource types within a specific date range, to avoid unnecessary storage costs or space usage. It can also help ensure the security and confidentiality of class data.

### Overview
Deletion tasks take effect within 24 hours of creation — you can check task history for the latest status. Tasks that haven't started yet can be canceled.

- Resources with protection lock enabled will not be deleted.
- You cannot create a new deletion task while another one is pending (not started or in progress).
- Deletion tasks cannot be created on the last day of the month (Beijing time).

### Notes
- Deleting "class recordings (playback videos)" affects whether teachers and students can watch the playback for the corresponding session(s).

### Related articles
- "Auto-Deleting Storage Resources"
- "Adding Sub-accounts in the Admin Console"

### Steps
1. Log into the Admin Console.
2. Go to School Settings in the left navigation.
3. Go to Storage Settings at the top.
4. Under "Delete Historical Storage Resources," create a deletion task.

<!-- DOC_BOUNDARY -->
```yaml
title: "Recordings, Monitoring Screenshots & Whiteboard Courseware Management"
source_title_zh: "录课视频、监课图片和板书课件管理"
```

## Recordings, Monitoring Screenshots & Whiteboard Courseware Management

### I. Preventing recordings, monitoring screenshots, and whiteboard courseware from being deleted

**Who this applies to**
- The Admin Console primary account
- Sub-accounts with "Class Resources" access

**When to use this**
Academic staff can enable a protection lock for a session's [Monitoring Screenshots], [Recordings], and [Whiteboard Courseware] in the Admin Console. Once locked, these cannot be deleted — even via a deletion task or "delete by time range for playback videos and monitoring screenshots" — protecting important recordings, screenshots, and whiteboard courseware from accidental deletion due to mistakes or mismanagement.

**Overview**
Once locked [Monitoring Screenshots], [Recordings], and [Whiteboard Courseware] exceed the 3-month free storage period, storage fees will automatically be deducted from your Admin Console balance. See "Billing Rules" under "Finance Overview" for details.

**Related articles**
- "Adding Sub-accounts in the Admin Console"

**Steps**
1. Log into the Admin Console.
2. Go to Class Resources in the left navigation.
3. Find the session.
4. Click "Protection Lock" on the right (green lock = protection enabled; gray lock = protection disabled).

### II. Deleting recordings, monitoring screenshots, and whiteboard courseware
Requires a sub-account with "Session Resources" access.

"Recordings (class playback videos)," "monitoring screenshots," and "whiteboard courseware" stored in the Admin Console for more than 3 months incur storage fees. To avoid unnecessary charges, you can delete recordings, screenshots, or whiteboard courseware you don't need to keep.

**Notes**
- Deleting a "recording (class playback video)" in the Admin Console affects whether teachers and students can watch that session's playback. Once deleted, the recording can no longer be watched — neither in the ClassIn app nor via a web playback link.

**Steps**
1. Go to Session Resources in the left navigation.
2. Select the session(s).
3. Click "Delete Screenshots," "Delete Recording," or "Delete Whiteboard Courseware" (or click "Delete Session Resources" to delete all resources for that session at once).

<!-- DOC_BOUNDARY -->
```yaml
title: "Recording Management"
source_title_zh: "录课视频管理"
```

## Recording Management

### I. Uploading a playback video

**Who this applies to**
- The Admin Console primary account
- Sub-accounts with "Class Resources" access

**When to use this**
If the teaching teacher can't record the class themselves but wants to preserve the session for students to watch later, a co-teacher in the classroom can enable local recording. If there's no co-teacher, academic staff can enter the corresponding classroom via the Class Monitoring page in the Admin Console and enable local recording there. After class ends, the co-teacher's or staff's locally recorded video can be uploaded to the "Class Playback Video" storage location for that session, creating a playback video.

**Notes**
- Videos can't be uploaded for a session that didn't have recording enabled.
- The Admin Console only supports uploading MP4 videos encoded with H.264. Incorrect encoding may result in audio-only playback with no video. Non-MP4 files may fail to play.
- The maximum supported resolution for uploaded videos is 1080p — videos above 1080p may fail to play.

**Related articles**
- "Adding Sub-accounts in the Admin Console"

**Steps**
1. Log into the Admin Console.
2. Go to Class Resources in the left navigation.
3. Find the session using filters, then go to Recording on the right.
4. Upload the playback video.

### II. Downloading a playback video

**(1) Downloading a playback video**

Academic staff can download a "class playback video" from the Admin Console to save it locally or share it with others. Staff can also download the video locally first, then delete it from the Admin Console to save on storage costs.

**Steps**
1. Download the playback video.

**(2) Bulk downloading playback videos**

1. Download the browser extension below.
2. Locate the "classin-download-help-2.1.1-chrome" archive on your computer.
3. Right-click the "classin-download-help-2.1.1-chrome" archive and choose "Extract to \"classin-download-help-2.1.1-chrome\" (C)".
4. Open Google Chrome, click the three-dot menu in the top-right corner.
5. Click "Add to Chrome" from the relevant link, then "Add Extension," then go to Extensions > Manage Extensions.
6. Enable "Developer mode" in the top-right, click "Load unpacked" in the top-left, and select the extracted "classin-download-help-2.1.1-chrome" folder.
7. Open the ClassIn recording video data page.
8. Click the Extensions icon in the top-right.
9. Click "classin-download-help-2.1.1," then bulk-download the videos.

### III. Deleting a playback video
If a teacher's recording is repeatedly interrupted or unstable during class, a co-teacher can enable local recording in the classroom, or academic staff can enter the classroom via the Admin Console to monitor and enable local recording. After class ends, staff can upload the locally recorded video to the corresponding session's "Class Playback Video" storage location, then delete the incomplete video that was recorded during the original session.

**Steps**
1. Delete the playback video (once deleted, a playback video cannot be recovered — proceed carefully).

<!-- DOC_BOUNDARY -->
```yaml
title: "Org Cloud Drive Management in the Admin Console"
source_title_zh: "后台组织云盘管理"
```

## Org Cloud Drive Management in the Admin Console

### I. Creating folders / uploading courseware

**What is the Org Cloud Drive?**
The Org Cloud Drive feature in the Admin Console and the ClassIn app are synced with each other. When a user creates an org cloud drive folder and uploads courseware in ClassIn, it automatically syncs to the school's Org Cloud Drive in the Admin Console. Conversely, when academic staff upload courseware and add org members via the Admin Console, those members can see the courseware after logging into ClassIn and opening the school's Org Cloud Drive.

Admins can create various folders and subfolders in the Org Cloud Drive, add members, and set member permissions. This turns each folder into a small shared collaboration space — for example, an "English Department" or "Grade 1" folder. This makes file sharing and management easier, and improves efficiency for file authorization and management at the school or organization level.

Through the Org Cloud Drive, teachers can more easily share, collaborate on, and manage teaching materials, fully supporting collaborative teaching needs. This significantly improves both file management convenience and teaching efficiency.

**Who this applies to**
- The Admin Console primary account
- Sub-accounts with "Org Cloud Drive" access

**Overview**

(1) Supported file formats that can be opened in the classroom:

- ClassIn whiteboard format: edb
- ClassIn file formats: edt, edu, eda, edv
- Presentation formats: pptx, ppt, pptm, pptippt
- Document formats: docx, doc
- Spreadsheet formats: xlsx, xls, csv
- PDF format: pdf
- Epub format: epub
- Image formats: jpeg, jpg, png, bmp
- Audio formats: mp3, wav, wma, aac, flac, m4a, oga, opus
- Video formats: mp4, 3gp, mpg, mpeg, 3g2, avi, flv, wmv, h264, m4v, mj2, mov, ogg, ogv, rm, qt, vob, webm
- Text document formats: txt, html, htm, css, js, as, cpp, c, cc, cxx, h, java, md, matlab, pascal, pl, php, py, r, rb, ru, sql, swift, rbx, rs, go
- Go (weiqi) format: sgf
- Chess/Xiangqi formats: fen, pgn

**Notes**
- The Org Cloud Drive feature is only available on the "Enterprise Edition" and "School Edition" of the ClassIn Admin Console.

**Related articles**
- "Adding Sub-accounts in the Admin Console"

**Steps**
1. Log into the Admin Console.
2. Go to Org Cloud Drive in the left navigation.
3. Click "Create Folder" in the top-left.
4. Name the folder and click Confirm.
5. Open the newly created folder.
6. Use the top-left to upload local courseware or folders.

### II. Adding members / editing member permissions
Requires a sub-account with "Org Cloud Drive - Member Management" access.

| Permission | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Can Manage | Can add, authorize, and remove members; can upload, delete, rename, forward, and use files. |
| Can Operate | Can upload, create, and use files, but cannot delete them. |
| View Only | Can preview files and use them in the classroom, but cannot upload, create, or delete them. |
| No Access | Cannot view files. |

- "Enterprise Edition" Admin Console can only add teachers from within the organization.
- "School Edition" Admin Console can add both teachers and students from the school as org folder members (students currently only support "View Only" permission).
- In the Admin Console, deactivating a teacher automatically revokes their Org Cloud Drive permissions. If a deactivated teacher is later reactivated, they'll need to be added again following the new-member permission process to regain access.

**Steps**
1. Find the folder you want to add members to, click "···" on the right, then select "Member Management."
2. Click "Add Member."
3. After adding members, adjust their permissions from the member management window.

### III. Downloading courseware
Requires a sub-account with "Org Cloud Drive - Download" access.

Supports bulk downloading of courseware.

**Steps**
1. Open the org folder.
2. Select the courseware to download.
3. Click "Download" at the top.

### IV. Copying courseware
Supports bulk copying of courseware.

**Steps**
1. Select the courseware to copy.
2. Click "Copy" at the top.
3. Choose the destination path.

### V. Moving courseware
Supports bulk moving of courseware.

**Steps**
1. Select the courseware to move.
2. Click "Move" at the top.
3. Choose the destination folder.

### VI. Enabling/disabling forward/save/download for courseware in the app
Supports bulk enabling or disabling of "forward/save/download" permission.

**Steps**
1. Select the courseware.
2. Click "Allow Forward/Save/Download" or "Disallow Forward/Save/Download" at the top.

### VII. Deleting courseware
Requires a sub-account with "Org Cloud Drive - Delete" access.

Supports bulk deletion of courseware.

**Steps**
1. Select the courseware to delete.
2. Click "Delete" at the top.

# 1. System Requirements & Device Info Lookup

<!-- DOC_BOUNDARY -->
```yaml
title: "Looking Up Device Info: Specs, Benchmark Score, Network Speed, Chip Model"
```

## Looking Up Device Info: Specs, Benchmark Score, Network Speed, Chip Model

## I. Checking Your Computer's Specs

### When to use this
Checking your computer's specs means reviewing its hardware and system details to confirm it meets the requirements for a specific piece of software. If you use a computer, you can refer to the hardware parameters in "System Requirements" and compare them against your own computer's specs to confirm whether it can run ClassIn.

### Steps

**(1) Windows computer**
1. Right-click "This PC" on the desktop.
2. Select Properties.
3. Under Device Specifications, check the RAM capacity and CPU model.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F207d74d5f0e039ef1498ace4e289f42cb4e480653d840eb3c47df6733319d61b_254401?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=82c2969925bd7134ba35e3fb67c100d9ed687e63)

**(2) Mac computer**
1. Open Launchpad.
2. Type "Terminal" in the search field, then open the Terminal app.
3. In the Terminal window, next to the prompt (e.g. `LeondeMacbook-Air:~ shouhouzhichi$`), type `sysctl machdep.cpu.brand_string`.
4. Press Enter.
5. The output will show your computer's CPU model.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fd8e2f7bd40c5df5a8612c7bb3e852b5d2fe0243d74dcf5560cb1859dd34fcea5_361026?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=24d5c2fa2a2f9e340e6f51170e22071a2f610772)

## II. Checking Your Network Speed

To ensure a stable connection while using ClassIn for online teaching or learning, please check your network before you start. Testing and optimizing your network settings in advance helps ClassIn run smoothly and supports your online teaching.

### Usage Notes
The key metrics to look at in your test results are: upload speed, download speed, latency, jitter, and packet loss rate. If your network doesn't meet all of the following requirements at once, you may experience connection instability or frequent disconnects while using ClassIn, which can affect the quality of your class.

| Minimum Network Requirements |
| --- |
| Upload speed: at least 2Mbps |
| Download speed: at least 2Mbps |
| Latency: within mainland China, no more than 50ms; outside mainland China, no more than 300ms |
| Packet loss: must be 0% |

1. Open your browser.
2. Enter the following in the address bar: https://www.speedtest.cn
3. Click Test Speed.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F46e397fb953659ed33b6119718556f27b879769eae8acb042399cad96d359215_366221?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=1c368b8a4de4a408039fe6447a6a79dccd3d22eb)

## III. Checking Your Device's Benchmark Score

### When to use this
Based on your computer's CPU model, you can look up its performance benchmark score on a dedicated CPU benchmark site to determine whether it can support ClassIn running normally.

### Usage Notes
Teachers' computers need a CPU benchmark score of 6000 or higher.

Students' computers need a CPU benchmark score of 4000 or higher.

### Steps
1. Go to https://www.cpubenchmark.net/cpu_list.php in your browser's address bar.
2. Enter your computer's CPU model in the search box.
3. Click Find CPU to search.
4. In the highlighted area on the left, find the option that exactly matches your computer's CPU model.
5. Check the value in the CPU Mark column on the right — that's your CPU's performance benchmark score.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F57ebd37b9391dcc022dca39ec54aa02be8efe5a589e51f54dec7efb985ed1179_379263?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=a6179c425172f8f5c7289fccf95558b10e6f3f36)

## IV. Checking Your Mac's Chip Model

ClassIn offers two installer packages for Mac: one for Intel-based Macs, and one for Apple silicon Macs (M1, M2, and so on). Before downloading an installer, you need to confirm your computer's processor type so you can pick the right one.

1. Hover over the Apple icon in the top-left corner of your screen.
2. Click About This Mac in the menu.
3. In the About This Mac window, check the CPU chip model next to Processor.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fa123ab72dc9c959fe87db4f2f7e97e2c25cae4e4e015a92b5a98d9815a6cfc25_461854?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=9a884733f148e07102c7b71df32b6837e017f04e)

## System Requirements

## I. What Are System Requirements?

System requirements refer to the specific hardware and software conditions a device needs to meet in order to run the ClassIn software. These requirements typically cover key elements such as the processor, memory, and operating system, which are the basic conditions for the software to run properly. Hardware requirements also vary depending on class size: as the number of on-stage participants in ClassIn increases, so do the hardware requirements needed to keep the software running stably and smoothly.

## II. Computer Requirements

| | Minimum requirements (students / teachers not recording) | Minimum requirements (teachers recording) | Recommended requirements (teachers / students) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Processor | Intel 8th-gen i3 or higher; AMD Ryzen 3 2nd-gen or higher | Intel 8th-gen i5 or higher; AMD Ryzen 5 1st-gen or higher | Intel 9th-gen i7 or higher; AMD Ryzen 7 2nd-gen or higher |
| Memory | Windows: 8GB RAM or higher; Mac: 4GB RAM or higher | Windows: 16GB RAM or higher; Mac: 4GB RAM or higher | Windows: 16GB RAM or higher; Mac: 8GB RAM or higher |
| OS | Windows 7 or higher; macOS 10.13 or higher | Windows 7 or higher; macOS 10.13 or higher | Windows 10 or higher; macOS 12 or higher |
| Display resolution | At least 1280 x 720 | At least 1280 x 720 | At least 1920 x 1080 |
| Network bandwidth | At least 2Mbps | At least 4Mbps | At least 6Mbps |

## III. Phone/Tablet Requirements

| | Minimum requirements (students / teachers not recording) | Minimum requirements (teachers recording) | Recommended requirements (teachers / students) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OS | iOS 11 or higher; Android 7.0 or higher; HarmonyOS 1.0 or higher | iOS 11 or higher; Android 10.0 or higher; HarmonyOS 2.0 or higher | iOS 14 or higher; Android 10.0 or higher; HarmonyOS 2.0 or higher |
| Memory | Android: 4GB or higher; iPad/iPhone: 2GB or higher | Android: 8GB or higher; iPad/iPhone: 2GB or higher | Android: 8GB or higher; iPad/iPhone: 3GB or higher |
| Processor | iPad/iPhone: A9 or higher. Android: Qualcomm Snapdragon 7-series 730G or higher; Snapdragon 8-series 835 or higher; Kirin 8-series 810 or higher; Kirin 9-series 970 or higher; MediaTek Dimensity 720 or higher; MediaTek Helio G90T or higher. | iPad/iPhone: A11 or higher. Android: Snapdragon 8-series 855 or higher; Kirin 9-series 980 or higher; MediaTek Dimensity 1000 or higher. | iPad/iPhone: A12 or higher. Android: Snapdragon 8-series 865 or higher; Kirin 9-series 9000 or higher; MediaTek Dimensity 1100 or higher. |
| iPad/iPhone models | iPhone 6 or later; iPad 5 or later; iPad mini 4 or later; iPad Air 3 or later; iPad Pro or later. | iPhone 8 or later; iPad 6 or later; iPad Pro or later. | iPhone XS or later; iPad 8 or later; iPad Pro 2 or later; iPad mini 5 or later; iPad Air 3 or later. |
| Network bandwidth | At least 2Mbps | At least 4Mbps | At least 6Mbps |

## IV. Recommended Devices for ClassIn X

Recommended device performance varies by teaching scenario:

**Dual-teacher classroom**

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F17766803a0c8c5cd1f6c361665599b60b57c960ecb9b915fcbb19071f3a640fd_100043?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=329f9adba452c88a144b07c0f7ec43fd3ac41910)

**Standard in-person teaching**

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fb8f0fd78dc217d592076750452affe93afff5f6def42a2f944e1047a904446df_119426?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=8c223e25fd4fb3ac83c68d1295ae42eee76c9cb6)

With minimum specs, supported features include: pen tool, courseware (PPT/PDF/audio-video, etc.), scan-to-share images, auxiliary camera, and other basic teaching tools.

With minimum specs, Nobook and Video Wall are not recommended.

With recommended specs, all features can be used.

## V. Recommended Devices for Dual-Teacher Teaching

The dual-teacher classroom model — a new exploration combining online and in-person teaching — became mainstream in 2015. By splitting the roles between an online lead teacher and an in-person homeroom/facilitation teacher, the dual-teacher classroom lets excellent teachers teach across regions.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F7cd38a3d4277c24347b109ecad3e542b9e0224e85e797599f5d990e83e919dd0_885358?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=a1c3b82b8bbb05039045350426d371e43dfc79a4)

An increasing number of partners are choosing ClassIn as their interaction tool for dual-teacher classrooms. To help users get the best teaching experience, we recommend the following hardware procurement plan:

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F6ef3fbf38d682224d94a4f0f45a0fec73d64e410cda3072a5a13883bf3ebeba4_138418?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=ee9c1339eb20a8b7f5866e5e316484816f6d3223)

## VI. Recommended Devices for Remote Meetings

EEO is committed to building the most professional online classroom product. In practice, ClassIn is also a very stable and convenient remote meeting system.

To help ClassIn users get a better remote meeting experience, we recommend the following hardware based on our own usage experience.

# 2. Download & Installation

<!-- DOC_BOUNDARY -->
```yaml
title: "Downloading and Installing ClassIn"
source_title_zh: "Classin下载与安装"
```

## Downloading and Installing ClassIn

## I. Installing ClassIn on Windows

### 1. Before You Download

**(1) Check your computer's specs**

Before downloading ClassIn, check your computer's hardware specs, including the CPU model, RAM, and operating system. Steps:
1. Right-click "This PC."
2. Select Properties.
3. Under Device Specifications, check the CPU model, RAM, and operating system.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F6c0ba30a2c29f907481639d7fcac2d07657379063c7731a076f9d9feb5e90b35_892437?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=261155599535c516d948cf4dc5ad3db01c21b67f)

**(2) Compare against the requirements table**

Compare the CPU model, RAM, and OS you found against the recommended specs below to confirm your computer meets ClassIn's requirements for class.

| | Minimum requirements (students / teachers not recording) | Minimum requirements (teachers recording) | Recommended requirements (teachers / students) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Processor | Intel 8th-gen i3 or higher; AMD Ryzen 3 2nd-gen or higher | Intel 8th-gen i5 or higher; AMD Ryzen 5 1st-gen or higher | Intel 9th-gen i7 or higher; AMD Ryzen 7 2nd-gen or higher |
| Memory | Windows: 8GB RAM or higher | Windows: 16GB RAM or higher | Windows: 16GB RAM or higher |
| OS | Windows 7 or higher | Windows 7 or higher | Windows 10 or higher |
| Display resolution | At least 1280 x 720 | At least 1280 x 720 | At least 1920 x 1080 |
| Network bandwidth | At least 2Mbps | At least 4Mbps | At least 6Mbps |

### 2. Downloading and Installing ClassIn

**2.1 Usage Notes**

ClassIn supports Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 10, Windows 11, and later. We recommend using Google Chrome or Firefox to download the ClassIn installer, as both browsers handle file downloads reliably.

To avoid installation issues, we recommend closing any antivirus or security software on your computer (such as 360 Total Security, 360 Antivirus, or Tencent PC Manager) before downloading the ClassIn installer. Such software can sometimes mistakenly flag ClassIn's registry files as a threat and delete them, disrupting the installation.

Official ClassIn download site (Chinese): https://www.eeo.cn/cn/download
Official ClassIn download site (English): https://www.classin.com/download

**2.2 Notes**

ClassIn does not support installation on: Windows XP, Windows 8.1 RT, or Windows Vista.

**2.3 Steps**
1. Open your browser.
2. Enter the following in the address bar: www.eeo.cn
3. Go to the Download Center.
4. Click to download the Windows version.
5. Once the download finishes, run the installer.
6. Follow the on-screen prompts to install ClassIn.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F700f387e666f14a2aad8c88a200c4d19e4b42493af5b23654e71802e6baab6fc_516474?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=33c44330c8a564c1484a6e5bd3162464664f95bc)

## II. Installing ClassIn on Mac

**(1) Check your CPU model**

Before downloading ClassIn, check your computer's CPU model. Steps:
1. Open Launchpad.
2. Search for "Terminal" and open it.
3. In the Terminal window, next to `LeondeMacbook-Air:~ shouhouzhichi$`, type `sysctl machdep.cpu.brand_string`.
4. Press Enter.
5. View your CPU model.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F2910229de3e8dc38f748ea122fe95ca3f0016f263bc74ff8c2d4db656ee8251a_2594456?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=5e1435815a88a33835581c2ad92b4a33ca67cc6c)

**(2) Check your CPU chip type**

To check your Mac's RAM, OS version, and CPU chip type:
1. Hover over the Apple icon in the top-left corner.
2. Click About This Mac.
3. In the About This Mac window, check the RAM, OS version, and CPU chip type next to Processor.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F2d253d122ed30a5098760d26b6d726c5958bd20605c7d3e4d37e2c7f0750154e_468319?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=cc5b23d83f80bba938b0e61308228aae61a848d2)

**(3) Compare against the requirements table**

| | Minimum requirements (students / teachers not recording) | Minimum requirements (teachers recording) | Recommended requirements (teachers / students) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Processor | Intel 8th-gen i3 or higher | Intel 8th-gen i5 or higher | Intel 9th-gen i7 or higher |
| Memory | Mac: 4GB RAM or higher | Mac: 4GB RAM or higher | Mac: 8GB RAM or higher |
| OS | macOS 10.13 or higher | macOS 10.13 or higher | macOS 12 or higher |
| Display resolution | At least 1280 x 720 | At least 1280 x 720 | At least 1920 x 1080 |
| Network bandwidth | At least 2Mbps | At least 4Mbps | At least 6Mbps |

macOS 10.13 and later supports downloading ClassIn. Since Mac computers currently on the market use one of two CPU chip types — Intel or Apple silicon — please check your CPU chip type and download the matching ClassIn installer from www.eeo.cn.

Official ClassIn download site (Chinese): https://www.eeo.cn/cn/download
Official ClassIn download site (English): https://www.classin.com/download

**2.2 Steps**

**Downloading and installing ClassIn for Intel chips**
1. Enter the following in your browser's address bar: www.eeo.cn
2. Click to download the macOS (Intel chip) version.
3. Run the installer and wait for it to verify.
4. Drag the ClassIn icon on the left into the Applications folder on the right, and wait for the copy to finish.
5. Open Launchpad and search for ClassIn.
6. Open ClassIn.
7. Wait for the first-launch verification, then click Open in the prompt that appears.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F2a329a83198014196bd331d7b968a7c2c375d25716271ad79d792530382f6305_753216?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=affeb1fefc47fd0d057ca36e1b0a2ef4848f4db0)

**Downloading and installing ClassIn for Apple silicon**
1. Click to download the macOS (Apple chip) version.
2. Drag the ClassIn icon on the left into the Applications folder on the right, and wait for the copy to finish.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F446eef78239c7fc3c7c8bd338e3b635e5196ffd138080af832470c8a9fd40ff6_804696?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=2100b1bfddb1c4abc9c6cfb4740b1f15b9fb8396)

## III. Installing ClassIn on iPhone/iPad

**(1) Check your device model**

Open Settings → General → About, and check the model name.

**(2) Compare against the requirements table**

Compare your phone or tablet's model against the recommended devices below to confirm it meets ClassIn's requirements for class.

| | Minimum requirements (students / teachers not recording) | Minimum requirements (teachers recording) | Recommended requirements (teachers / students) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OS | iOS 11 or higher | iOS 11 or higher | iOS 14 or higher |
| iPad/iPhone models | iPhone 6 or later; iPad 5 or later; iPad mini 4 or later; iPad Air 3 or later; iPad Pro or later | iPhone 8 or later; iPad 6 or later; iPad Pro or later | iPhone XS or later; iPad 8 or later; iPad Pro 2 or later; iPad mini 5 or later; iPad Air 3 or later |
| Network bandwidth | At least 2Mbps | At least 4Mbps | At least 6Mbps |

If you're using an iPhone or iPad, make sure your iOS version is at least iOS 11 before downloading ClassIn. Then download ClassIn from the App Store:
1. Open the App Store.
2. Search for "ClassIn."
3. Tap Get on the right.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F3dab7ff0f41b326a1620a30446d480d747d27e40dc1b8bcc55961af703a7d8ac_283439?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=af29619a575607b2e72db0c772de8d5b6d78584c)

## IV. Installing ClassIn on Android Phones/Tablets

**Huawei phones/tablets**: Open Settings → scroll to the bottom → About Phone → check the CPU model next to Processor and the RAM next to Memory.

**Xiaomi phones/tablets**: Open Settings → My Device → check the CPU model next to Processor and the RAM next to Memory.

**OPPO phones/tablets**: Open Settings → scroll to the bottom → About Phone → check the CPU model next to Processor and the RAM next to Memory.

**vivo phones/tablets**: Open Settings → scroll to the bottom → About Phone → check the CPU model next to Processor and the RAM next to Memory.

Compare your phone or tablet's specs against the recommended processors and other specs below to confirm it meets ClassIn's requirements for class.

| | Minimum requirements (students / teachers not recording) | Minimum requirements (teachers recording) | Recommended requirements (teachers / students) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OS | Android 7.0 or higher; HarmonyOS 1.0 or higher | Android 10.0 or higher; HarmonyOS 2.0 or higher | Android 10.0 or higher; HarmonyOS 2.0 or higher |
| Memory | 4GB or higher | 8GB or higher | 8GB or higher |
| Processor | Qualcomm Snapdragon 7-series 730G or higher; Snapdragon 8-series 835 or higher; Kirin 8-series 810 or higher; Kirin 9-series 970 or higher; MediaTek Dimensity 720 or higher; MediaTek Helio G90T or higher | Snapdragon 8-series 855 or higher; Kirin 9-series 980 or higher; MediaTek Dimensity 1000 or higher | Snapdragon 8-series 865 or higher; Kirin 9-series 9000 or higher; MediaTek Dimensity 1100 or higher |
| Network bandwidth | At least 2Mbps | At least 4Mbps | At least 6Mbps |

If you're using an Android or HarmonyOS device, make sure your Android device is running at least Android 7.0, or your HarmonyOS device is running at least HarmonyOS 2.0, before downloading ClassIn. Steps:
1. Open your device's built-in app store.
2. Search for "ClassIn" in the search bar.
3. Tap Install on the right.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F806c51e81e52f479f0f5ce7cd7b024b33f49ca8d7912a6256aff5110b63b4ed4_234077?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=cdcc0bf4b2f4eafd8aa2634c95d2c0cef1bc5104)

```yaml
title: "Resetting Your Password"
```

## Resetting Your Password

### When to use this
If you forget your ClassIn login password, you can use the "Forgot Password" feature in ClassIn to reset it.

### Notes
There is a combined daily limit of 10 SMS, email, and voice verification codes. Once you reach this limit, you won't be able to request any more codes that day.

### Steps

**Computer/tablet**
1. Open ClassIn.
2. Click Forgot Password.
3. Enter your phone number or email, click Get Verification Code, and set a new password.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F0f6fa0e62ca38f34fe74c832c347011364226ee814910e2358b1e9df81d90cd5_165422?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=dfd8e413f21299e3c2188706cb27425b92345633)

**Phone**
1. Tap Other Login Methods.
2. Tap Forgot Password.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fa0685e22d2df7e1579aa02d472ab402dbc1d71f0501f1ddb63052c91f0b5b604_352147?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=df15e826f1a151f9c1080cabf2737da0161a265f)

```yaml
title: "Registering an Account"
source_title_zh: "注册账号"
```

## Registering an Account

### Prerequisites
Before registering for ClassIn, make sure you have a phone number or email address that can receive verification codes normally, so you can receive the registration code.

### Usage Notes
When registering for ClassIn, if you don't receive the SMS verification code, wait 60 seconds, then tap to request a "voice verification code."

Non-Chinese phone numbers can also be used to register a ClassIn account — just make sure to select the correct country code during registration. For example, for a US phone number, select "+1."

Voice verification codes are only supported for mainland China phone numbers (with the +86 country code).

Users in mainland China who register with an email address will need to verify with a phone number as well.

There is a combined daily limit of 10 SMS, email, and voice verification codes. Once you reach this limit, you won't be able to request any more codes that day.

### Steps

**Computer/tablet**
1. Open ClassIn.
2. Click Sign Up Now.
3. Enter your phone number or email, click Get Verification Code, and set a login password.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fb3aef5b6eba384c3526339ee1e0e21d0b579401eb2c21597f08e8a8e66ed598f_500566?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=2b9cb820d96c24f77b6212457eb9afb771c030d4)

**Phone**

If you haven't registered yet, simply tap "One-Tap Login with This Number" — you'll be registered automatically, or you can complete registration manually.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fdd6a87f0f7c8cfda624a7b5755944fbf3631905e5e645451c86ef9e90ab0dbd9_200486?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=762629466e4a71da3e871ebb15d1422561ee13d8)

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F86adfda6b28b4164af127ace53c2927fb68e50e9bd863e97aaa9d3439ff57fa5_615867?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=df506f1bc962f14a183d7d3c6e8377664777b8db)

## Logging In to ClassIn (Account/Password, One-Tap, QR Code, Verification Code, WeChat or Apple)

## I. Logging In with Account and Password

### Related Articles
"Registering an Account"
"Resetting Your Password"

### Steps

**Computer/tablet**
1. Open ClassIn.
2. Enter your registered account and password to log in.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F3867cb48e08459a7c547984a66d02d95d2bab15b739a337ac0292f09eb4e2c0e_249848?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=92d6542dfc2581dc5e17e0d7c7a8aae515987ecc)

**Phone**
1. Tap Log In with Another Account, then enter your registered account and password to log in.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fd6a57df3932bbe80948e11b0b45d4091f9e8764a1b6ec65f61db5ffebf83a3b1_707046?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=5186b4c41d64080b2610db56e2098847b045385b)

## II. One-Tap Login on Phone

### Prerequisites
Your phone must have an active, working SIM card to use "One-Tap Login with This Number."

### Notes
This feature is not available for computer or tablet users.

Tap "One-Tap Login with This Number" to log in to ClassIn directly.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fca2529fdad1945b2c6dc75408779bb7cecec1b02bca81644869116c226a9cfe5_185839?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=6431edb3d7f77e0a0e4f6d43fb2fed83893cbd2a)

## III. QR Code Login

### Usage Notes
First, install and log in to ClassIn on your phone or tablet, or make sure ClassIn is already linked to your WeChat account. Then open ClassIn on your computer and use the "scan" feature in the ClassIn or WeChat app on your phone or tablet to scan the QR code shown on the ClassIn login page on your computer, to complete login.

1. On your computer, open ClassIn and click QR Code Login.
2. On your phone/tablet, open ClassIn or WeChat and log in.
3. Tap the "+" icon in the top-right corner of ClassIn or WeChat on your phone/tablet, and select Scan.
4. Scan the QR code shown in ClassIn on your computer.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fc931b1bc2dc51f63d0c3713a2b3b81a8c2b42a20c6fdaf279d16c53017a50f95_271344?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=d8e76c71acd14efd75575af761b982959874be8c)

## IV. Verification Code Login

Make sure your phone or email can receive SMS or emails normally before using the verification code login feature.

There is a combined daily limit of 10 SMS, email, and voice verification codes. Once you reach this limit, you won't be able to request any more codes that day.

1. Open ClassIn.
2. Tap Other Login Methods.
3. Tap Verification Code Login.
4. Enter your phone number or email, then request a verification code.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F71953d3e3359fed4d7a58fea6948377b39aac2c29b4695e6a440b189f291f8d3_1032011?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=12f6209f2658558664bad3afbd1ba59e6e433a43)

## V. WeChat or Apple Login

Once you've linked ClassIn to your WeChat or Apple ID on your phone or tablet, you can log in with WeChat or Apple.

1. Open ClassIn on your phone or tablet, and tap Other Login Methods.
2. Tap WeChat Login or Apple Login.
3. Complete the linking verification to log in.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F6db5d11b10cbb7db59b44726882c704a0be24b33b8990dcfbab9acbb4ac448b5_680426?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=19ff48c14c388c01d4a743197d7ffbe575b4c5ab)

# 4. Class Management

<!-- DOC_BOUNDARY -->
```yaml
title: "Class AI Apps"
source_title_zh: "班级AI应用"
```

## Class AI Apps

## I. Class AI Agent Chat

### Applies to
Head teachers and class teachers.

Once the head teacher enables "Students can use AI apps" in the class's AI App Settings, students can use it too.

### When to use this
ClassIn 6.0 deeply integrates advanced AI technology to build a powerful "AI Agent Platform," designed to drive teaching innovation and comprehensively improve teaching efficiency through intelligent tools. Teachers can flexibly enable and manage various official AI apps based on their specific teaching needs — like having a team of professional smart teaching assistants.

### Usage Notes
Class teachers, and class students who are allowed to use AI apps, can chat with AI agents, including AI Teaching Assistant, AI Learning Analytics, and any agents added independently from the AgentIn agent store.

**AI Teaching Assistant:** answers student questions based on the class's teaching resources (such as courseware and documents), recommends relevant content, or provides hints toward an answer — offering students round-the-clock personalized Q&A and resource guidance, supporting self-directed learning, and reducing the burden of repetitive Q&A on teachers.

**AI Learning Analytics:** dynamically analyzes classroom interaction, assignment completion, and other learning data to generate visual reports on knowledge mastery, learning progress, and classroom participation — helping teachers precisely understand student status and make informed decisions for personalized, differentiated teaching.

### Steps

**Computer/tablet**
1. Go to Home.
2. Find and enter the class.
3. Click AI Agent.
4. Start chatting.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Ffde827394fafe3d23a4c6dc872fea1628bbd32f7eabf10508c66ce0f0b7846e2_397205?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=b8251dddc4dd3a99628ad9dee7cb9b272da4e8b1)

**Phone**

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F47ee321b7eec644d0138bf89bdeec41df7871bc019b3290c625edf440c267baa_1278620?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=99f13a2c200fb5656af5bd239dc26055a261645e)

## II. Creating an AI Agent for the Class

Head teachers and class teachers can use a computer to go to the class's AI Apps, then open the AgentIn agent store to create an agent.

You can create an AI app by selecting an existing template. Once created, you can publish the agent to the agent store for everyone to use, or set its visibility to "only me." Published agents can be found and used under "Created by Me." Agents published to the store can be found on the homepage by filtering by the store category you set before publishing. Published agents can be edited, deleted, or unpublished from "Created by Me."

You can also import agents already published on platforms such as Flowin, Coze, Yuanqi, and FastGPT. Imported agents can be edited or deleted from "Created by Me."

In addition, any agents you create or import will also appear by default in "My Favorites."

Tablets and phones do not support creating AI agents.

### 1. Creating an AI Agent

#### Steps

**Computer**
1. Find AI Apps and click "+."
2. Click "Created by Me," then click "Create AI App" in the top-right corner.
3. Configure the AI app info and template, then click Next.
4. Once configuration and testing are complete, click Publish.
5. Set the visibility and other details, then click Confirm Publish.
6. Go to "Created by Me" to view the agent you created.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fa8201e850aec768fb4787ec2848697f46e9a10ed2543696850483c039b11be76_1476655?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=ca2e87b1cd942a8abf03dce0482a704cf83b5f31)

### 2. Importing an AI Agent

1. Click "Created by Me," then click "Import App" in the top-right corner.
2. Enter the agent's ID and personal access token, then click Import.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F206671f478146b99aa94f08a9ebb2d6fb101d400fb0e0be2f607404fbf6acd69_539655?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=dfabc97153d7bc43984de273aef9718f3ebbb902)

## III. Adding an AI Agent to the Class

Head teachers and class teachers can use a computer or tablet to go to the class's AI Apps, open the AgentIn agent store, and add an existing agent to the class for teachers and students to use.

The first time you open the AgentIn agent store, you'll need to select your role, grade level, and subject; the system will recommend suitable agents based on your selections. These selections can be changed anytime from the bottom-left corner of the AgentIn agent store.

On the Home page, you can browse agents listed in the agent store; you can filter by role and subject/grade level in the top-left corner. Click into an agent to view its trial page, where you can add it to your class.

Agents you've created or imported appear by default in "My Favorites" — click into one there to add it to your class.

Adding AI agents is not supported on phones.

Find and click the agent, then click Add.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F18679be3bbacbeb0628504df96e3474890bbebf62233a9b05666f689a9cc7cc5_953538?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=ccefaf5477fdc1d3e16aff5a62254291a19fe2fb)

## IV. Deleting an AI Agent from the Class

Head teachers and class teachers can delete an AI agent that was previously added to the class's AI Apps. Once deleted, the agent can no longer be used. Note: the AI Teaching Assistant and AI Learning Analytics agents cannot be deleted.

Find AI Apps, click "···," then click Delete.

## Class Announcements

## I. What Are Announcements?

Teachers can post announcements in a class for important notices.

## II. Creating an Announcement

### Applies to
Head teachers and class teachers.

### Usage Notes
Teachers can post announcements within a class, and can sync an announcement across multiple classes at once (as long as the teacher posting it holds a teacher role in each of those classes). To make sure every student sees the announcement, you can enable the "require students to confirm they've read it" feature when creating the announcement. Announcements can also be pinned — a pinned announcement appears at the top of the class chat group so teachers and students can find it quickly.

Announcement content can include text and files. File limits: up to 15 image attachments, up to 15 video attachments, and the combined total of local courseware, cloud drive courseware, and links cannot exceed 15. Each video or other file must be under 500MB, and each image under 25MB.

### Steps

**Computer/tablet**
1. Go to Home.
2. Find and enter the class.
3. Click Announcements on the right.
4. Click Post New Announcement.
5. Enter the announcement content, then click Post.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F566b30c84be273a051f00e5a1b4a1f51752cae756392e9d0796b0a188b2dc650_382984?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=bf75ad197325d157057419cd2e3114aab664924a)

**Phone**
1. Go to Home.
2. Enter the class.
3. Tap "X."
4. Tap Announcements in the bottom-right.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fbf288063502a3bda40e02df43820ef639dbaac309104e3a900cc8e62ef0425fb_2437465?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=bc6cc548a24f611dd89fc05fe28c8da5cfec0731)

## III. Editing an Announcement

Applies to head teachers and teachers.

Published announcements can be edited — you can change the content and pin status. The selected classes and the "require students to confirm read receipt" setting cannot be changed.

1. Click a published announcement.
2. Click Edit.
3. Make your edits, then click Save.

Click Edit Announcement.

## IV. Deleting an Announcement

Published announcements can be deleted.

Click "···," then select Delete.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fcc8b2c2436b1734cc57d37eceb0d3b9b72aff742384d8efd346c9015a34ad949_390003?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=600b4c5f799eb5a505de4758be60c18e99eb7f04)

## V. Sharing an Announcement

Published announcements can be shared to other apps for notification purposes and to view the text content; to see the full announcement including attachments, open it in the ClassIn app.

When a teacher shares an announcement from a computer, they can copy a QR code or save it as an image to share.

When a teacher shares an announcement from a phone or tablet, they can share it to WeChat contacts, WeChat groups, or Moments, or share it by copying a link.

After a teacher opens a published announcement, if any students haven't viewed or confirmed it, the teacher can click the "Remind Unconfirmed Students" button — ClassIn will push a notification reminding those students to view the announcement.

Click Remind Unconfirmed Students.

## Class Co-Creation

## I. Creating a Co-Creation Page

### What is co-creation?
The co-creation feature is similar to a class bulletin board. Once a class uses co-creation, class members can jointly view and edit its content.

### Applies to
Head teachers and class teachers.

Class students can view co-creation content, and if the head teacher enables "Allow students to edit co-creation documents" in the co-creation settings, students can also add to and edit co-creation pages.

### Usage Notes
Students and teachers with edit permission can create and edit co-creation pages. Besides basic features like typing text and using tables, co-creation pages support uploading images, audio, video, and files, and using AI features for writing, drawing, and more.

### Steps

**Computer/tablet**
1. Enter the class.
2. Create a new co-creation page, or open an existing one.
3. Add content.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F0b8b5ffdd996538cfc44a5a7f35823f7e521b5c371bc3eb0af1b52ca0bcb1bbb_405083?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=494642a70eeb7d19faec898df075ce8800142843)

## II. Co-Creation Settings

Applies to head teachers.

Once the head teacher enables "Students can edit co-creation documents" in the co-creation settings, students can create or edit co-creation content on the class co-creation page.

If students need to use AI features (such as AI writing or drawing) while creating or editing co-creation content, the head teacher can enable "Students can use AI features" in the co-creation settings.

2. Find and enter the class.
3. Click the class name.
4. Go to Co-Creation Settings.
5. Turn "Students can edit co-creation documents" and "Students can use AI features" on or off.

## Creating / Dissolving / Leaving a Class

## I. Creating a Class

### What is a class?
A class is the basic educational unit a school organizes to achieve a specific educational goal. It includes students and teachers, and promotes student learning and growth through teaching and group activities. On the ClassIn online education platform, classes serve several key roles:

**The basic unit of teaching activity:** Classes are the basic unit for conducting teaching activities — teachers can create courses within a class, teach online, and manage learning. Students can access teaching resources and join discussions through the class.

**Encouraging student interaction and collaboration:** In the class chat area, students can communicate and collaborate with other members or teachers through text messages, discussion, and other interactions, improving learning outcomes.

**Making it easier to manage learning progress and content:** Teaching staff can create different series of courses within a class, making it easier to organize and manage students' learning progress and content across different courses. Students can find the courses they need within the class and study according to their own plans.

### Applies to
In ClassIn, any user can create a class, though the settings and features available may differ depending on the ClassIn edition. Classes are mainly created by school teaching staff, head teachers, or course teachers, who have more permissions and features available in ClassIn.

### When to use this
Creating a class helps organize and manage student learning activities more efficiently. A class brings students of the same or similar grade level together to study and communicate in a unified environment. By creating a class, teachers can better understand and track student progress and provide timely guidance and support. At the same time, a class gives students a shared platform for learning, encouraging collaboration and mutual support.

In addition, a class helps foster students' sense of community and teamwork, giving them a chance to build well-rounded skills and social abilities. Creating classes is therefore important for establishing an orderly, positive learning atmosphere and improving the quality of education and teaching.

### Usage Notes
A class can offer a variety of teaching features, including but not limited to:

**Chat:** In "Chat," all class members can send text messages, voice messages (phone and tablet only), stickers, images, and files from their computer or cloud drive, encouraging interaction.

**Courses & Activities:** Teachers can create units and activities under a course. Activities include class sessions, recorded courses, assignments, quizzes (exam papers), answer sheets, discussions, learning materials, and AI Speaking Cards — providing diverse content and formats for teaching.

**Grades:** In "Grades," teachers can view students' grades and competency scores across various learning activities, giving a full picture of student progress and ability, to support individual tutoring and further guidance.

### Related Articles
"Adding Teachers/Students to a Class"

### Steps

**Computer/tablet**
1. Go to Home.
2. Click Create Class.
3. Set the school the class belongs to, the class avatar, and the class name.
4. Click Create and Enter Class.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F5c9bffa04ced4bcc86cceb6db05e26823984f29441b1d620281e0ad6d51ee4c2_92656?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=8b3669d5f66eef9e0d705cfe095cd7bf6d251ce6)

**Phone**

Set the school the class belongs to, the class avatar, and the class name. Tap Create and Enter Class.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F5c6e72f5a41d880e709a7bb48d13c66e64618dccc95c06a797059526f167fad2_248584?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=bb628e03fd2c8dad29576041f2aa81b1cb5e6748)

## II. Dissolving a Class

### Applies to
Head teachers.

Dissolving a class means no longer providing any teaching support or guidance for it. After a class is dissolved, it will remain in the user's ClassIn "Schedule," where users can still find dissolved classes. In a dissolved class, members can no longer post any kind of discussion in the class chat area, and class teachers can no longer create new teaching activities within the class. However, class members can still normally watch playback videos of lessons that already took place in the class. Note: if a class still has a class session (lesson) that hasn't started, or one currently in progress, the head teacher will not be able to dissolve the class — they must wait for all class sessions (lessons) in the class to end first.

A class cannot be deleted or deregistered — it can only be dissolved by the head teacher, from class settings.

Whether students can continue to watch playback videos of past lessons and course activity attachments after the class is dissolved depends on the class settings.

1. Find and enter the class.
2. Click the class name.
3. In Class Settings, click End Class.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F515a5a52cddecaa87d6ab3cb415e54226de86c51a128d1312b1e0ffef4372edd_763119?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=b0f669fe3735084753c5a5cadb5500933b84c4cc)

Find and enter the class, tap ">" to the right of the class name, then tap End Class.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F1eef59245237c2a37b2e351c8626915b5e705dd3bfc4911ce07e055a484c2646_260410?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=dd6ba031f55f72f75af9b8c77bb1e2756bf4f566)

## III. Leaving a Class

Applies to class teachers and students.

**Class created by a free-tier user:** students can leave the class at any time.

**Class created by a trial-tier user:** teachers with unfinished lessons cannot leave the class; leaving is allowed in all other cases.

**Class created by a paid-tier user:** teachers and students can leave the class 60 days after the class's last lesson has ended.

1. Click Class Settings.
2. Click Leave Class.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fbe3254bb2709fdb5af2ba8bd5ac61af564258eb351babbb8aaad99d168d3bdb9_336809?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=5bc5a24af625dfcb260d69d5cf46762b69808799)

Click Leave Class.

## Class Member Management

## I. Sharing the Class Sign-Up Entry / Adding Students to a Class

### Applies to
Head teachers and teachers can share the class sign-up entry with users who want to join.

### Prerequisites
Before sharing the class sign-up entry, the head teacher must enable "Open Class Enrollment" in Class Management.

### When to use this
Sharing the "class sign-up entry" means providing teachers and students with a self-service way to join a class. Through this entry, teachers and students who aren't yet in the class can join it on their own. This entry can be a "class QR code" or a "class invitation code." The goal is to make sign-up more flexible and convenient — for schools or organizations, sharing the class sign-up entry can effectively reduce manual work and improve management efficiency.

### Usage Notes
Any teacher member of the class can share the "class QR code" or "class invitation code" with teachers and students who need to join.

Teachers and students who haven't joined the class yet can use the scan feature in the ClassIn app to scan the "class QR code" shared by a class teacher, or tap the link in the "class invitation code" shared by a class teacher. This lets them sign up and join the class — new members join as students by default.

### Steps

**Computer/tablet**
1. Go to Home.
2. Find and enter the class.
3. Click the "+" to the right of Members.
4. Share the QR code or invitation code, or directly add a friend to the class.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fc7d0a18d399488ff350baf34b03336776e2095fc5a0cfa1b2d8f49d813900dcf_285167?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=59bd7e4230051f1a16c0b9bad8bdada0b3b59eb0)

**Phone**
1. Tap ">" to the right of the class name.
2. Tap "+" next to Class Members.
3. Share the invitation code or QR code, or directly add a friend to the class.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F7722c926da864f7e1158635cdfef56d38d32caa0a2a207554b36e8cf2acd3c34_277680?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=68a24a183d176b733501beff9bf78655a34bd5f0)

## II. Adding a Teacher to a Class

Applies to head teachers.

During class management and instruction, you may need multiple teachers to help the head teacher manage the class, or to take on different teaching roles during lessons. To ensure lessons run smoothly and classroom order is maintained, the head teacher should add relevant teachers to the class in advance. This way, when creating a lesson, suitable teachers can be selected from the class members to fill the appropriate roles, improving teaching quality and management efficiency.

Existing teachers in the class can share the "class QR code" or "class invitation code" with teachers not yet in the class. Invited teachers can use the scan feature in the ClassIn app on their phone to scan the class QR code, or tap the link in the class invitation code, to join the class.

Once a teacher successfully joins, they join as a student by default. At this point, the head teacher needs to change the newly joined teacher's role from student to teacher, so they can get the additional permissions. Note: only members with a class teacher role (including head teachers) can be assigned as the lead or co-teacher of a lesson.

### Notes
Teachers who newly join a class default to a "class student" role — a "head teacher" in the class needs to change the newly joined teacher's role from "class student" to "class teacher."

1. Click "+" next to Members.
2. Share the QR code or invitation code with the teacher who needs to join.
3. Click Members.
4. Find the newly joined teacher in the Student List, click "···" on the right, and select Set as Teacher.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F3b832faac0fcc5f139b2798449da853ede687ca3a132ef3c3d176bf8cb4e7ec9_456203?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=1eeaa96bfc76d4ea33369350e47e6526b3b596d0)

Share the invitation code or QR code with the teacher who needs to join. Tap "< Invite Members" to go back to class settings. Go to Class Members → Student List, find the newly joined teacher, tap "···" on the right, and select Set as Teacher.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fa35a2af728ec4535362b42874bc8e1b91366ffb5ca9e6cbd180c28e21130d7a5_411445?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=e4024cae3ca217ebd6e0a6c45a54c0f4019b8595)

## III. Removing a Class Member

When a teacher or student in the class is no longer taking part in teaching or learning there, the head teacher can remove that member from the class to prevent them from continuing to attend classes there.

The head teacher can remove students from the class. If a student is removed while a class is in session, that student will be immediately and forcibly removed from the classroom, and the system will notify them that their access to the lesson has been revoked.

The head teacher can also remove teacher members from the class. Note: if a teacher is currently teaching a lesson or has an upcoming lesson that hasn't started, the head teacher will not be able to remove that teacher — this ensures the teacher can finish an ongoing lesson or one about to start, without unnecessary disruption to the schedule.

Whether a removed student can still watch playback videos of past lessons and course activity attachments depends on the class settings.

1. Find the teacher or student, click "···" on the right.
2. Select Remove Member.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F9d81ddb2e6981f4a32eea9f274fd880d71e4c08d1e19bd519f0af7937b1649c5_331081?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=a2829abde09817f809cbbafba08abcb5811c228b)

Find the member, click "···" on the right, and select Remove Member.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F03510968f2b534f59da8adc958f0bfdcc97a3a4ea703609ba383cad1cc508617_295042?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=28841ec0a8e1f2cff6cd9e07dd5084621ee3c5c0)

## IV. Setting Member Nicknames

### 1. Teachers Changing Class Members' Nicknames

Head teachers and teachers can change a student's class nickname.

Head teachers can change the nickname of any teacher in the class.

For student management, teachers can add a class nickname for students to make it easier to manage them. This helps teachers quickly identify students in class group chats, classroom discussions, and other scenarios, improving the efficiency and accuracy of class management.

For teacher management, to more easily manage multiple teachers (including foreign teachers) within a class, the head teacher can add a class nickname for teachers. This helps students quickly identify teachers (including foreign teachers) in class group chats, classroom discussions, and other scenarios.

Setting a class nickname helps teachers quickly identify students, or helps students quickly identify teachers among several, which is especially useful in a one-to-many teaching environment. Using a student's class nickname, a teacher can communicate, guide, and evaluate the student more quickly. For students, having a specific class nickname also strengthens their sense of belonging and identity, and helps students get to know and interact with each other within the class.

Select Set Class Nickname.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F6f807bfb40410f3603e38d3c91fb9d537c0d2c89573fe38c1428c85f8609e05f_335652?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=3970351bb690f4b436201a0854e0d4e35c809d67)

Find the teacher or student, then click "···" on the right.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fc98438db8535f2259da1bba1764d4bad1b70fb21f362ade98112b2514d3190ca_294186?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=8331b8db414d481abe72d97c04323bd0ccb3c5c0)

### 2. Changing Your Own Class Nickname

Applies to all class members.

Head teachers and teachers can change their own class nickname at any time. If the head teacher has enabled "Allow students to change their class nickname," students can also change their own class nickname in class settings.

1. Click the class name.
2. Change your class nickname under "My Nickname in This Class."

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fac1de61acf19b2491d69b537776cb10cd22418484e036d8a9b3556f31388e078_786351?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=fcab7be414258bd9784f514bfcb46a55cc9d7069)

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fbf87b237fd139312324418ceff1df890c04e9bd28aa44a81dd89567b013622d1_270358?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=a8b965bea556e02d9eb745f906f30d37d3bf6657)

## V. Grouping Class Members

Applies to head teachers and teachers.

Teachers can create groups within a class and sort students into different groups as needed. When creating a learning activity, teachers can then assign it to specific groups, making learning activities more flexible and personalized.

Only computer supports creating groups; on tablet, groups can be viewed and selected when creating a learning activity.

**Computer**
1. Click Members.
2. Go to Group Management to set up member groups.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Ff0679e0879237661cb2eebac6c1b9b38daade461cf29a031d0d391dfdc22b940_363708?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=8a0ec6dee6f287e61d6eab101769630776fffc6f)

## Class Teaching Plans and Learning Plans

## I. Enabling Teaching Plans

### Applies to
Head teachers.

### Usage Notes
Once the head teacher enables this, head teachers and teachers can view and edit teaching plans within the class's course, allowing them to adapt to different teaching scenarios and improve teaching flexibility and effectiveness. If this feature is disabled, head teachers and teachers won't be able to see teaching plans in the class.

### Steps

**Computer/tablet**
1. Go to Home.
2. Find and enter the class.
3. Click the class name.
4. Go to Course Settings.
5. Turn Enable Teaching Plan on or off.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F1736954d1ded73d45af2271ccd83174b4a9f87ed1398472c4c916de06e5457ac_517847?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=a88604349fffcbdb104191e60e887d9e49b96cec)

**Phone**
1. Find and enter the class.
2. Tap "X."
3. Tap ">" to the right of the class name.
4. Turn Enable Teaching Plan on or off.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2F76fef46cd2b11bcb5d702b3fe1d5dffae3f7382ca2f0d39f85e08cb4794b1233_1686060?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=00a4f4d3a37d443484c4545d8ef9efd05251876a)

## II. Creating a Teaching Plan

Applies to head teachers and class teachers.

Once the head teacher enables teaching plans in Course Settings, head teachers and teachers can view and edit teaching plans in the class's course. Content supports adding text, images, and file types such as Word, PDF, images, audio, video, and Markdown, as well as using public templates, AI, and clipping (pulling in content from a third-party webpage).

1. Create a new course, or open an existing one.
2. Click Teaching Plan.
3. Edit the teaching plan.

![](https://cofile.eeo.cn/res-store%2Fbf30c127f6feed9fc3d30ef4de41336337bc53db76a03a99525c57dcf33b5be2_419171?q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=AKIDJQGsEOK2TfbFdEZifMnxrWx85mpdHj6H&q-sign-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-key-time=1773936000;1774540800&q-header-list=host&q-url-param-list=&q-signature=0d9a02c4029f542b75eb343e4ea275e7850a27de)

## III. Enabling Learning Plans

Once the head teacher enables this, head teachers and teachers can view and create learning plans, and students can view the learning plans a teacher created in the corresponding course.
